name: Halloween Scrooge
source: Halloween Scrooge is "A Christmas Carol" meets Halloween, and you can flirt with the ghosts!  You're the grumpy main character, freshly moved to a new town and unenthusiastic about celebrating Halloween. Three handsome ghosts make it their mission to convince you otherwise.
